mechanism: Alendronate may impair gastrointestinal absorption of vedolizumab due to its caustic effects on the GI mucosa and strict dosing requirements, while vedolizumab's immunosuppressive effects may theoretically increase infection risk in patients with compromised bone metabolism.
action: Separate alendronate and vedolizumab dosing by at least 2 hours; monitor for GI symptoms and ensure adequate calcium/vitamin D supplementation; assess infection risk periodically given vedolizumab's mechanism.
